solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Substitute defence player in an up and down situation

parts.note: to substitute one thing for another is to switch them
in football or rugby a back is a defensive player

explanation.surface: A manager brings on a replacement defender while the match swings back and forth.
explanation.definitionFit: A switchback is a road or ride of steep rises and falls, a roller-coaster course that goes up and down.

clue.text: Frame band

definitions.meaning: the sliding frame holding the glass in a ... window
a strip of cloth worn over the shoulder or round the waist

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the glazed frame of a window and a ceremonial ribbon worn across the body.

clue.text: Narrow-minded libel liar put about

indicators.note: put about means turned round or thrown into disorder, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bigot spreads a defamatory falsehood around town.
explanation.definitionFit: Illiberal means intolerant and opposed to free thought, a synonym for narrow-minded.

clue.text: Paint one Central American native

parts.note: a coat is a layer of paint, and to paint is to coat
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An instruction to decorate a single figure from Central America.
explanation.definitionFit: The coati is a raccoon-like mammal whose home range includes Central America.

clue.text: Informed of plot involving umpire accepting bribe essentially

indicators.note: involving means the plot word wraps round what follows

parts.note: a bed is a plot of ground in a garden

indicators.note: accepting means the umpire word takes the next letter inside it

parts.note: ref is short for referee, an umpire

indicators.note: the essence of a word is its central letter, here the middle of bribe

explanation.surface: Told about a scheme in which an official was paid off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Essentially' takes the central letter of 'bribe'; 'accepting' sets it within the umpire to make RIEF, and 'involving' sets that within the plot.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone briefed has been given instructions or information, so is informed.

clue.text: Mark everything up after dice thrown

indicators.note: after places the reversed piece behind the rearranged one
dice that are thrown land at random, so these letters are jumbled
in a down entry, up means the word for everything is read from bottom to top

parts.note: all means everything

explanation.surface: A gambler totals the score after rolling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' reads as a verb, to tot up a score, but it is a noun for a written sign. 'thrown' jumbles the dice into CEDI; 'up' turns the word for everything into LLA.
explanation.definitionFit: A cedilla is the diacritic hook under a c, as in façade, so it is a mark.

clue.text: Where to buy birdcage?

definitions.meaning: the ... is a British chain of cooperative grocery shops
a pen or cage for poultry

explanation.walkthrough: The Co-op is a long-established British supermarket chain run as a cooperative.
explanation.definitionFit: Written without its hyphen the shop name is also the word for a hen enclosure.

clue.text: Shrub's more promising with top clipped

indicators.note: in a down entry the top is the first letter, which is cut off

parts.note: rosier means having brighter prospects, more promising

explanation.surface: A gardener's remark that a bush looks healthier after pruning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with top clipped' takes the first letter off ROSIER.
explanation.definitionFit: The osier is a willow grown for basketry, a woody bush.

clue.text: Branch of medicine for those with a mind to study

definitions.text: Branch of medicine for those with a mind to study

parts.words: Branch of medicine for those with a mind to study
parts.note: 'with a mind to' looks like 'keen to', but the field is literally the study of the mind

explanation.walkthrough: 'With a mind to study' reads as 'eager to learn', yet the discipline studies minds themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: This medical specialty diagnoses and treats mental illness, so its subject is the mind.

clue.text: Regiment with area to hold line dance

indicators.note: to hold means the regiment's letters enclose the line letter

parts.note: the SAS is the Special Air Service regiment

explanation.surface: Soldiers with room to spare form up for a line dance.
explanation.definitionFit: Salsa is a lively Latin American partner dance.

clue.text: Slight, tiny gin I'd prepared

indicators.note: prepared means made up or mixed, like a drink, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Someone is offended by the small measure of gin they have mixed.
explanation.definitionFit: A slight is an insult, and an indignity is a humiliating affront.

clue.text: Old woman on support, one receiving gift

indicators.note: in a down entry on means placed above the next piece

parts.note: gran is an affectionate word for grandmother, an old woman
a tee is the peg that supports a golf ball

explanation.surface: A grandmother living on benefits is given a present.
explanation.definitionFit: A grantee is the recipient of a grant, a gift of money or property.

clue.text: British boundary almost overflowing, having no empty space

parts.note: a rim is an edge or boundary

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of that word is dropped

parts.note: full to excess is overflowing

explanation.surface: A British border so packed it is spilling over.
explanation.definitionFit: Filled right to the top edge, a vessel brimful has no room left in it.

clue.text: Exclamation of dismay echoing occasionally in Chagar Bazar

indicators.note: an echo comes back, so the chosen letters are read in reverse
occasionally means only every other letter of the place name is taken

explanation.surface: A cry of horror sounding around Chagar Bazar, an archaeological site in Syria.
explanation.walkthrough: 'occasionally' takes the even letters H G R A A; 'echoing' turns them round.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a cry expressing frustration or horror, an interjection of dismay.

clue.text: Self-loving unstable man's crisis

definitions.note: an adjective standing for the noun meaning excessive love of oneself

indicators.note: unstable means shaky and not fixed, so these letters fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A troubled man going through a personal breakdown.
explanation.definitionFit: The condition named after Narcissus, who fell for his own reflection, is vain self-admiration.

clue.text: Feather-brain's base for operations in enemy territory

definitions.text: base for operations in enemy territory
definitions.meaning: a secured area behind enemy lines into which troops and supplies are flown

explanation.definitionFit: The word is slang for a scatterbrain and also the military counterpart of a beachhead, reached by aircraft.

clue.text: Observe brood of pheasants gathering for dance

parts.note: eye, or nye, is an old collective noun for a brood of pheasants
a ball is a formal social gathering for dancing

explanation.surface: Watching a flock of game birds assembling as if for a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eye' as a brood of pheasants is an obsolete collective noun.
explanation.definitionFit: To eyeball something is to look at it closely, to observe it.

clue.text: Feeler from worker woman rejected

parts.note: a worker ant is the classic crossword worker

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the name is read backwards

parts.note: Anne is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A sensitive employee feels the sting of a woman turning them down.
explanation.definitionFit: An insect's antenna is a sensory organ used to touch and sense, a feeler.

clue.text: Be rough in joggling someone close

indicators.note: joggling means jolting or shaking about, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Advice to play roughly when jostling a person beside you.
explanation.definitionFit: A neighbour is one who lives or sits nearby, so a person close at hand.

clue.text: School allergies from time to time absent in Eton?

indicators.note: from time to time absent means every other letter is dropped, leaving the alternate letters of the two words

explanation.surface: A boarding school pupil's hay fever keeps them out of class now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: 'School' looks like the definition, but it is fodder: dropping its odd letters and those of 'allergies' leaves the even ones.
explanation.definitionFit: Eton's full name ends with this word, so the school is an example, flagged by the question mark.

clue.text: European catalogue including Italian exclusive type

indicators.note: including means the catalogue word takes the Italian letters inside it

parts.note: a list is a catalogue of items
It is the abbreviation for Italian, as in It vermouth

explanation.surface: A snobbish European directory with an Italian entry.
explanation.definitionFit: An elitist favours a select few and excludes others, an exclusive sort of person.

clue.text: A row about English student's workshop

indicators.note: about means the row word goes round the other letters

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
L is a learner, the student driver's plate

explanation.surface: An argument concerning an English pupil's studio.
explanation.definitionFit: An atelier is an artist's or designer's studio, a workshop.

clue.text: Firm in depression cutting alcohol

indicators.note: cutting means the depression slices into the drink word

parts.note: ale is an alcoholic drink
a dent is a hollow or depression

explanation.surface: A company in a slump curbs its drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasta cooked al dente is firm to the bite, so the phrase means firm.

clue.text: Pie's turning a brown colour

indicators.note: turning means the letters are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A pie is going brown in the oven.
explanation.definitionFit: Sepia is a reddish-brown pigment from cuttlefish ink, also the tint of old photographs.

clue.text: Measures high voices

definitions.meaning: a pipe is a large cask, a measure of wine

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both large wine casks used as units of volume and piping treble singing voices.

clue.text: Comprehensive's useless having taken on daughter and husband

indicators.note: having taken on means the useless word takes the daughter letter inside it

parts.note: inept means incompetent or useless

explanation.surface: A comprehensive school is failing despite recruiting a family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Comprehensive' looks like a British state school; it is the adjective meaning thorough.
explanation.definitionFit: A study in depth is thorough and detailed, so comprehensive.

clue.text: Hand round a soft fruit

indicators.note: round means the hand word goes about the other letters

parts.note: a paw is a hand, informally
p, piano, is the musical notation for soft

explanation.surface: Passing round a ripe, squashy fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The papaw is a tropical fruit, another name for the papaya.

clue.text: Ordered 'Stop all ado, removing restraints!'

indicators.note: restraints hem something in at both sides, so the outer letters of each word are removed

explanation.surface: Someone commanding an end to fuss and setting people free.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removing restraints' strips the first and last letter of each word, leaving TO, L and D.
explanation.definitionFit: Being told to do something is being ordered to do it.

clue.text: Driving force of limousine almost out of control, restricting power

indicators.note: restricting means the jumbled letters enclose the power letter
out of control means the remaining letters career into a new order
almost means the final letter of the car word is dropped

explanation.surface: A limousine is careering wildly, its engine power unchecked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims LIMOUSINE to LIMOUSIN; 'out of control' rearranges that to IMULSION; 'restricting' puts P inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Impulsion is an impelling push or impetus, a driving force.

clue.text: Petty officer clutching erotic picture

indicators.note: clutching means the officer's letters hold the other word

parts.note: hot can mean sexy or erotic

explanation.surface: A naval rating grasping a saucy image.
explanation.definitionFit: A photo is a photograph, a picture taken with a camera.

clue.text: On the radio, overlooked dimness

indicators.note: on the radio means the word is heard spoken, not read

parts.note: something overlooked was missed

explanation.surface: Something broadcast was ignored in the gloom.
explanation.definitionFit: Mist is a thin fog that blurs sight, a haziness or dimness.

clue.text: Sadly older, worth a spiritual life elsewhere

indicators.note: sadly means badly or wretchedly, so these letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: Growing old and rich, someone hopes for an afterlife.
explanation.definitionFit: The otherworld is the realm beyond this one, a spirit world or afterlife.
